about.title: About the project
about.lead: Noova is an adult listings catalogue in Germany. We connect people who publish a profile with people looking for one, and take no part in what they agree between themselves.
about.whatText: A catalogue where people publish their own profile: description, photos, services, rates and ways to get in touch. We do not match anyone to a client, do not arrange meetings and take no cut of any arrangement. Our job is the shop window, the search and the order in it.
about.howText: A profile is created and run by its owner. She decides what to show, which services to list and at what price. Every profile and every photo is checked by a moderator before it goes live. Contacts stay hidden until a visitor presses “Show contacts”, so they cannot be harvested automatically.
about.whoText: For independents, salons and agencies who want a shop window without middlemen. And for visitors who want a search that works: filters by services, appearance, price and district, a map, favourites and reviews from other clients.
about.safetyText: The site is for adults only. Technical data, including capture coordinates, is stripped from photos. Location is shown as an area of about a kilometre, never an address. Reviews are published after review. Anyone can report a profile without registering, and reports about minors or signs of coercion are handled first.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.lead: Write to us about anything: publishing a profile, payment, complaints, technical problems.
contact.reportText: If you see a profile that breaks the rules, you can report it right on its page — no account needed. That way the report reaches a moderator with the profile attached. Reports about minors or signs of coercion are handled first. If someone is in immediate danger, call the police on 110.

advertising.title: Publishing a profile
advertising.lead: Placement is paid with GlowCoin, our in-house currency: you top up a balance and the cost of a listing is taken from it.
advertising.priceNote: This is the lower bound — the price for one month. Six- and twelve-month terms cost less per month, and the top-up bonus makes GlowCoin cheaper than the base rate. Exact amounts are shown in your account before anything is charged. Ask support about payment terms and tax details — they will appear here once agreed.

advertising.includedPhotos: Photo processing with technical data removed

advertising.howText: <register>Create an account</register>, fill in the profile and submit it for review. Once a moderator approves it, top up your GlowCoin balance and pick a term. For payment questions, <contact>write to us</contact>.
advertising.currencyText: Noova's in-house currency. Top up with crypto, GlowCoin never expire, and larger top-ups earn a bonus.
